meaning:
1) a shearing, mowing
1a) shearing, that sheared off
1b) a mowing, mown grass

elsewhere.note: You shall give him the first fruits of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.
if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;
He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: and behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and behold, it was the latter growth…
